question.question_text: User No.23853 gave a comment to a post at 9:08:18 on 2013/7/12, was that post well-finished?

verdict.reading: NOT_EQUAL states that these two statements disagree on this data under this rule. It does not state which of them is wrong.

projection_names_differ.reading: The two statements name their result columns differently. A projection is compared by position and declared type, so these names did not decide the verdict. gold.executed_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN T2.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'NOT well-finished' ELSE 'well-finished' END AS resylt FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T1.UserId = 23853 AND T1.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'

SELECT p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL 
FROM comments c 
JOIN posts p ON c.postid = p.id 
WHERE c.userid = 23853 AND c.creationdate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0';
